verdict.rationale: HelixDB's quickstart and CLI let a developer spin up a local/embedded 'dev' instance with generated seed data (helix chef) that is separate from any Helix Cloud production database, which functions as an ad-hoc sandbox; run-modes docs confirm the same queries/SDKs work across local and cloud deployments so testing locally won't touch production data. However, there is no explicit 'sandbox' or staging environment feature, no data-masking/cloning-from-prod workflow, and no documented promotion path from sandbox to production. Missing for 10: dedicated staging/sandbox environment concept, prod-data cloning/anonymization tooling, and independent confirmation that local testing is isolated from cloud production at the account level.
